faq_subtitle: Everything you need to know about quotas, privacy, subscriptions, and tools.
faq_q1: How does the 3 free daily operations limit work?
faq_a1: Every visitor and free starter account is granted 3 free document operations or format conversions per 24-hour cycle. Once you reach 3 operations, you can upgrade to DocuPulse Pro for unlimited daily usage, or wait until midnight for your free credits to automatically replenish.
faq_q2: Are my uploaded files and sensitive PDFs secure and private?
faq_a2: Yes, absolutely. Most PDF manipulations (merging, splitting, rotating, image formatting) happen directly in your web browser memory without ever leaving your device. When AI OCR or cloud compression is invoked, files are transmitted over 256-bit SSL encrypted channels and automatically wiped within 60 minutes.
faq_q3: What is included in the DocuPulse Pro subscription?
faq_a3: Pro unlocks unlimited daily operations across all 12 tools, raises your max file upload size to 200MB (vs 15MB on Free), enables batch processing up to 50 files simultaneously, activates Gemini AI OCR and summarization, and removes all queue wait times.
faq_q4: Can I convert scanned documents and photos into editable Word (.docx) or Text?
faq_a4: Yes! Our AI OCR tool uses high-precision optical character recognition powered by Gemini multimodal intelligence to extract text, tables, and lists from scans and photos, which you can export to Word, CSV, or formatted Markdown.
faq_q5: Can I cancel my subscription at any time?
faq_a5: Yes, you can cancel your monthly or annual subscription with one click from your User Dashboard at any time. You will retain full Pro access until the end of your current billing period with zero cancellation fees.
